title: Sales by Category groups by category, never by matrix
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35, pricing a second new category made for this test, category B, as well.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, with a part in category A and a part in category B, cost $100.00 each, priced $135.00 each, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Category.
  2. Pick customer B in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Category opens.

Step 2:

  • Category A and category B are two rows, $135.00 each.
  • Matrix A's name is not a row.
